tasks.title: Define authored bindings and exact derivative provenance
tasks.goal: Implement the typed authored binding and distinct base/local/result identities.
steps: Add DerivationBinding grammar with owner/resource IDs, exact base capture/resource/interpretation, retained local source and explicit operation recipe.
Define framed provenance/result hashes and generated result schema; equal output bytes must not erase distinct ownership/provenance.
Use migration primitives for any changed authored format, preserve comments and reject ambiguous legacy input.
positive_cases: Bindings round-trip while retaining authored local source and exact base.
Same result bytes from different bases/owners remain distinct provenance records.
negative_cases: Duplicate identity, absent exact base or ambiguous source interpretation refuses.
A copied upstream logical ID cannot masquerade as a new derivative.
checks: SELECT BEFORE DISPATCH: vibe-core target/cases are TO BIND from source/metadata to affected positive/negative obligations; choose --lib, --test <name>, --bin <name>, or affected --doc before compiling.

RUN BOUND CHECKS: after binding, use cargo test -p vibe-core <target> <case> -- --exact for lib/test/bin, or a reviewed small family without --exact; bind supported rustdoc selection separately. Verify intended nonzero cases in output; use target-specific --list only when needed to confirm selection, and reuse its valid inventory.

CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo xtask check-codegen only when the actual diff affects schemas, generators, generated-output registration or a dependent contract. Bind a narrower existing oracle if available; the global command needs that concrete impact and no adequate narrower check.

CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo xtask wire-diff only when the actual diff affects wire/format behavior, its corpus or epoch semantics. Bind a narrower existing oracle if available; the global command needs that concrete impact and no adequate narrower check.

CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo run --quiet -p vibe-cli -- check --path . --quiet only when actual spec/boot/dependency composition impact requires whole-project validation. Otherwise bind an existing appropriate root or focused declared-source checks; the write perimeter alone is not a trigger.

CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo run --quiet -p vibe-cli -- facts check --exhaustive only when actual facts/adoption/reference/extraction or closure-contract impact requires exhaustive validation. Otherwise bind affected claim/source checks; the write perimeter alone is not a trigger.
cargo fmt --all -- --check
git diff --check
acceptance: Strict schemas/corpus cover authored and generated carriers.
Stored result retains a complete navigable base→local→result chain.
tasks.safe_stop: Binding/provenance schema and pure validation work before writes.
tasks.commit_subject: feat(derivatives): record exact local binding and provenance
notes: Schema changes: inspect the existing codegen entrypoint before regeneration; never hand-edit generated types or invent a new codegen command. The listed check-codegen and wire-diff oracles are conditional on the actual affected inputs, never on the allowed write perimeter alone.
Registration perimeter includes existing crate manifests and module owners only for required exports/dependencies; do not change unrelated declarations.

tasks.title: Separate compatibility from activation authority
tasks.goal: Implement independent compatibility and effect-admission decisions for local derivatives.
steps: Validate an optional export target against the derived result's actual interface without prohibiting local creation.
Expose compatible/incompatible/unknown diagnostics and allow an explicitly selected alternative supported target.
Require new descriptor/artifact identity and exact M-08/M-14 grants before executing/deploying code-bearing results; no upstream trust inheritance.
positive_cases: A sealed source can be forked locally and inspected even when one target rejects its interface.
Compatible derivative activation succeeds only with its own grant.
negative_cases: Incompatible target cannot be mislabeled supported.
Base signatures, grants or package installation cannot authorize changed result effects.
